title: CompatibilityAndValidationRules
description: Rules engine schema for enforcing physical, electrical, geometric, and functional compatibility across spacecraft components

chassis_rules.description: Enforces volumetric and mass limits per chassis class

voltage_bus_rules.description: Validates that all active components operate on a common bus voltage or valid DC-DC converter line

pointing_budget_rules.description: Ensures that ADCS pointing accuracy is smaller than or equal to the minimum instrument requirement

thermal_rejection_rules.description: Ensures that TCS heat rejection capacity meets or exceeds total internal electronic dissipation

energy_balance_rules.description: Verifies that daytime solar generation replenishes nighttime battery discharge plus margin

mass_margin_rules.description: Enforces AIAA S-120 Mass Growth Allowance (MGA) thresholds
